question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who is bad in spellings
solution:
The correct answer is** "Cacographer"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's see the correct answer for the given group of words:

__
 
• **Cacographer -** One who is bad in spelling

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will learn another one word substitute:

 
• **Orthographer -** a person who spells correctly
